items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did that show as a substitute when ... Steve Allen. ... I worked over there as a sub on that show.

ctx.x: I can understand that, that that would just have been too difficult a decision.

Oh, I was cutting my own throat. I did – I don’t know if I mentioned to you. I did – when The Tonight Show – I did that show as a substitute when – what’s-his-name was there. Who was there? Before Jack Parr – Steve Allen.
